in_sanskrit.name: Bheru
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of War
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bheru एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bheru is a Sanskrit name derived from the God Bhairava, the embodiment of fierce power and courage. He is revered as the God of War and is invoked for protection and strength. The name Bheru signifies bravery and fearlessness, inspiring those who bear it to face challenges with determination and valor.
